items.text:
I can't do this anymore. The game isn't finished, it's not even close. 

The devs added more content for 1.0, but I don't care. The base game is one of salvaging derelicts and building up your own ship, and this system BARELY WORKS. The logic involved in hauling anything you strip off a derelict is terrible. The logic for transporting items to construction is terrible.

What's the solution? Well, the astute gamer probably already guessed, MODS! Mods fix everything right? Well, the developer also decided to make native workshop support as much of a backburner issue as his core gameplay loop. After struggling with BepIn, you know, one of the most commonly used mods, and finding it impossible to get working, this is where I'm at.

I can't stand playing the intended gameplay loop anymore because of the terrible logic. I can't mod around it, despite there being MULTIPLE mods to address this GLARING oversight from the developer. I have been with this game since some of its earliest days. Every time there was a massive update, I came back to test it out, see how I liked it, and EVERY TIME I walked away going "Not ready yet, good update."

So of course when 1.0 was announced, I was very excited. It had even been a longer than average gap in playing, so I had a lot to look forward to. So you can imagine my utter disappointment when I find that the logic for hauling and construction have barely changed; aghast that my character STILL doesn't understand how to use backpacks, dollies, or COMMON SENSE FOR GODS SAKE when moving ANYTHING on my ship.

And if you're reading this review and thinking, "Surely it can't be that bad. Surely this user is just being hyperbolic." No. I'm really not. You can go and do other things, once you have money. But to get that money, you (generally) need to do the core gameloop. And by the time you really want to build up a ship, or really want to strip a derelict for all you can... you'll understand as you watch your man take a single floor tile, ignore his backpacks (which they fit in), ignore the dolly he's currently pulling, and walk ALL THE WAY to your ship to drop off ONE tile (they stack to FIVE). You'll understand.

To the dev, because I loved Neo Scavenger and I DO still believe in your vision. ♥♥♥♥♥♥♥ fix this. This is rediculos, and if you don't know that, you should. If you want your community to solve your terrible logic for you, then make mod integration a bigger priority. But you need to pick one and fix this. I don't care about any other content you add to the game until this is resolved. Period.
items.text_zh:
我再也受不了了。这游戏根本没做完，差得远呢。

开发者给1.0加了更多内容，但我不在乎。基础玩法就是打捞废弃飞船、建造自己的飞船，而这套系统几乎没法用。搬运从废弃飞船上拆下来的任何东西，其逻辑都糟糕透顶。把物品运到建造处的逻辑也糟糕透顶。

那解决办法是什么？机灵的玩家大概已经猜到了，MOD！MOD能解决一切，对吧？可开发者偏偏把原生创意工坊支持也当成核心玩法循环一样，扔到最不重要的位置。在跟BepIn——你知道的，最常用的MOD之一——折腾半天，发现根本没法让它跑起来之后，我就卡在这儿了。

因为那糟糕的逻辑，我再也受不了按设计好的玩法循环去玩了。我也没法用MOD绕开它，尽管有多个MOD专门针对开发者这个刺眼的疏漏。我从这游戏很早的时候就一直跟着它。每次有大更新，我都会回来试试，看看自己喜不喜欢，而每一次我离开时都说‘还没准备好，更新不错’。

所以当1.0宣布时，我当然非常兴奋。而且距离上次玩已经隔了比平时更久，所以有很多值得期待的东西。于是你可以想象我有多失望：搬运和建造的逻辑几乎没变；我有多震惊：我的角色在船上搬任何东西时，居然还是不懂怎么用背包、手推车，或者他妈的常识。

如果你读这篇评测时心想：‘不可能那么糟吧。这用户肯定是在夸张。’不。我真没有。有钱之后你可以去干别的。但要拿到钱，你（通常）就得跑核心玩法循环。而等你真想造一艘飞船，或者真想尽可能拆光一艘废弃飞船时……你就会明白了，你会看着你的角色拿起一块地板砖，无视他的背包（明明装得下），无视他正拉着的手推车，然后一路走回你的飞船，就为了放下一块砖（它们能叠到五块）。你就会明白了。

致开发者：因为我爱《Neo Scavenger》，而且我仍然相信你的构想。他妈的把这修好。这太荒唐了，如果你不知道，那你该知道。如果你想让你的社区替你解决这糟糕的逻辑，那就把MOD整合当成更优先的事。但你必须二选一，把这修好。在这解决之前，你往游戏里加什么其他内容我都不在乎。就这样。

I tried to play this game and I give up.
The choice of graphics looks terrible on a 1440 monitor and its almost impossible for me to actually tell what I'm looking at.
The tutorials explain some things in detail and completely ignore other things, this makes trying to do anything not covered by them an exercise in frustration.
I tried to add some mods to maybe make flying the ship less tedious and learned that the workshop isn't very useful and you have to get some files from GitHub to mod the game files yourself. And even then they probably wont work.
I wish people would stop using this kind of faux retro art style for games, it really does make it vastly harder to play.

items.text:
I want to preface this review by saying that I adore this game. I've played it for many hours - hell, I've made what is arguably one of the first major expansion mods for the game.

With that, I have to say that I cannot recommend this game as it stands. I have no doubt it'll be good in, say, three years, but as it stands? No.

The game is straight-up broken, as it stands. The developers have prioritised completing their promised roadmap over anything else and it shows. 
Despite all the hype around the complex NPC system, said NPCs can't even, like, stay alive. I was docked at the major station you always start at for an extended period of time for periods and whatnot, and a significant amount of NPCs there just died. It should also be noted that said NPCs don't actually do anything interesting. You won't see people getting into arguements and whatnot, the most complex activity they can perform is the maintenance techs in stations repairing damaged modules. All these promises of a living, breathing world, and the NPCs can't even stay alive in environments where all their needs are provided for.

This jank extends to all levels of gameplay - for example, a major (dare I say, even central) point of the game is building yourself a ship with parts you pull from wrecks. Not only are the ship designs used here are rather poor (for a variety of reasons I can't get into here) but the 'damage pass' meant to simulate scavengers picking over the wreck is very poorly implemented. The result is that, while supposedly-incredibly-rare things like reactor parts are relatively easy to find, common electronics like O2 pressure sensors are incredibly rare. Despite the whole salvage economy thing, none of these common parts are readily available for purchase either. In the time it took me to find enough parts to build a mighty freighter capable of interplentary travel, with a reactor and various atmo-scrubbers and whatnot, I still hadn't found enough sensors for the various life support systems I had. To this day, despite pulling dozens of reactors off of wrecks, I do not have the contaminants sensor I need to plug into my contaminants scrubber. This makes ship-building incredibly frustrating.

The entire 'social needs' system falls flat because there's no way to meaningfully fulfill any of them. All these social needs, and the gameplay boils down to doing nothing but clicking the same 'doomscroll on social media lol' button over and over again, then pressing the 'cocoon' option to recover the privacy you lost doomscrolling on social media.
And for some reason, doomscrolling on your PDA is significantly better than any other way of filling these needs. That's the funniest part - the game doesn't facilitate, say, going down to Mescaform to get a drink with your crew, but even if you managed to chat someone up down there, that's still the sucker's way of filling those needs because the 'social interaction' system, being closer to 'social combat' than conversation, sucks at filling those needs.
In this game, social activitiy is a bad way of filling social needs.

Character creation is also very, very bad. A lot of the traits are basically meaningless ('Lustful' for example just means your intimacy need goes up slightly faster) but there are a few that are cripplingly bad. For example, 'Zero-G Hypervolemic' affects a huge variety of things.
A funny detail here is that the player character starts with all the 'cripplingly bad' traits by default. A lot of the game's difficulty comes from beginners not knowing that they can go to their trait selection, remove the crippling stuff and replace them with meaningless 'downsides' like Lustful that nonehtless give you the trait 'years' (Each positive trait you take makes you older, and each negative trait makes you younger in this game.) you need to start in the same age and condition as before, but now you're expontentionally more capable.
'Make sure to not take the traits that cripple you forever' isn't much of character creation. I'd have much preferred a system like Project Zomboid, where you have to balance positive traits with negative ones. Taking the 'smoker' trait to make up for my great athlethic capabilities felt much more of a meaningful decision than just removing the 'Do not forget to remove these' traits at the start and not doing much else.

Speaking of mecahnics, this one is a bit minor but none of the stations actually orbit their parent body. This is especially noticable at Venus Orbital where you can match the station's orbit and speed, and it will just accelerate away. All this talk about simulated ship systems and docking generally just involves accelerating at your target at full speed because orbitals aren't actually orbiting.

The maps you play across are also very weird as well. Even the more 'modest' locations you find are supposedly inhabited by hundreds of people but they look like they could maybe support five. The biggest 'aerostat' colony in the game, around Venus, has a grand 'mall' that's like, five company stalls and that's it. The grand starport (which is a seperate facility, you have to take transit down to the colony proper) can support maybe two ships. At an age where games like Star Citizen can offer believably-scaled facilities, it feels odd for supposed megaports to have like two docks. Hell, Ostranauts is a 2D game with very little overhead in huge maps, I know because I've made one myself. So it's really weird to see the illustration about the Venus aerostat colony with a huge crowd of people among skyscrapers, with a maglev line going overhead... then walking around the actual in-game map where it's a few rooms and that's it. It doesn't have to be 1:1 of course, but really? You couldn't make any attempt to pass off the supposed scale here?

I also want to speak about the modding scene a bit here. The game technically has Workshop support but anything beyond simple .json remixes require third-party loaders, and the developers, being extreme fence-sitters, have not forbidden mods with custom assemblies but has forbidden mods from loading their own assemblies. The end result is that mods with custom assemblies still exist, but now the whole process is just worse for no reason. Users have to manually install things like BepInEx in jank ways. Updates are a pain, the whole process is vulnerable to man-in-the-middle attacks, so on and so forth.
A lot of the game is also explicitly written in a way to discourage modding. For example, adding new stations, planets, etc. is technically trivial, you just plug in a few values like what it should orbit, how far it should be, etc. but in practice, it's impossible, because the game, despite supporting the custom star system format, explicitly only loads one star system with the name 'NewGame' and ignores the rest. Not only that, but the game *can* handle mods providing their own star system. It just chooses to explicitly ignore them and, in the case of systems with the same 'NewGame' name, chooses to completely override instead of merging. This means that a mod looking to add a new location either has to provide a full replacemement of the entire star systems (Super jank and breaks any other mods also looking to do the same) or you have to write a bunch of custom code to inject your new elements (Not only significantly more complicated than it should be, but runs into the 'no official custom assembly support' issue mentioned above) - This is just one example but a lot of the game's code is like this. At every step of modding, you run into either deliberate ignorance or just plain incompetence. Something is hardcoded in a very specific way, or something very laborous doesn't a common helper you can just plug stuff into.
items.text_zh:
我想在开头说，我非常喜欢这款游戏。我已经玩了很多小时——见鬼，我还为这款游戏制作了可以说是最早的大型扩展模组之一。

话虽如此，我必须说，就目前的状态而言，我无法推荐这款游戏。我毫不怀疑它在大约三年后会变得很好，但就目前而言？不。

就目前而言，这款游戏简直是坏掉了。开发者把完成他们承诺的路线图置于其他一切之上，这一点显而易见。
尽管围绕复杂NPC系统的宣传铺天盖地，但那些NPC甚至连活着都做不到。我曾在你总是会起始的那个主要空间站停靠了很长一段时间，处理生理期之类的事情，而那里相当多的NPC就那么死了。还应该指出的是，那些NPC实际上并不会做任何有趣的事情。你不会看到人们争吵之类的事，他们能执行的最复杂活动就是空间站里的维护技师修理受损模块。所有这些关于一个活生生、会呼吸的世界的承诺，而NPC甚至无法在一切需求都得到满足的环境中活下去。

这种粗糙贯穿了游戏玩法的各个层面——例如，游戏的一个主要（我敢说，甚至是核心）要点就是用你从残骸中拆下来的部件为自己建造一艘飞船。不仅这里使用的飞船设计相当糟糕（出于各种我无法在此展开的原因），而且那个本意是模拟拾荒者翻检残骸的‘损伤处理’实现得也非常差。结果是，虽然像反应堆部件这种据说极其罕见的东西相对容易找到，但像氧气压力传感器这样的普通电子元件却极其稀有。尽管有整套打捞经济系统，这些普通部件也不容易买到。在我花时间找到足够部件、造出一艘能够进行星际航行、配有反应堆和各种大气净化器之类的强大货船时，我仍然没有找到足够传感器来供应我拥有的各种生命维持系统。直到今天，尽管我从残骸上拆下了几十个反应堆，我仍然没有那个需要插进我的污染物净化器的污染物传感器。这让造船变得极其令人沮丧。

整个‘社交需求’系统彻底失败，因为没有任何办法能有意义地满足其中任何一项。有这么多社交需求，而玩法却归结为除了反复点击同一个‘在社交媒体上末日刷屏 lol’按钮之外什么都不做，然后再按‘茧居’选项来恢复你在社交媒体上末日刷屏时失去的隐私。
而且不知为何，在你的PDA上末日刷屏比任何其他满足这些需求的方式都明显更好。这才是最好笑的部分——游戏并不支持比如说下到Mescaform和你的船员喝一杯，但即使你设法在那里跟人搭讪，那仍然是满足这些需求的傻瓜方式，因为‘社交互动’系统更接近‘社交战斗’而不是交谈，在满足这些需求方面很烂。
在这款游戏里，社交活动是满足社交需求的一种糟糕方式。

角色创建也非常、非常糟糕。很多特质基本上毫无意义（例如‘好色’只是意味着你的亲密需求上升得稍微快一点），但有几个则糟糕到会严重削弱你。例如，‘零重力高血容量’会影响一大堆东西。
这里有个有趣的细节：玩家角色默认就带着所有那些‘糟糕到会严重削弱你’的特质。这款游戏的很多难度来自于新手不知道他们可以去特质选择界面，移除那些会严重削弱自己的东西，并用像好色这样毫无意义的‘缺点’来替换它们，而这些缺点尽管如此仍会给你所需的特质‘年份’（在这款游戏里，每选一个正面特质都会让你变老，每选一个负面特质都会让你变年轻），让你以和之前相同的年龄和状态开局，但现在你的能力强得不成比例。
‘确保不要选那些会永远削弱你的特质’算不上什么角色创建。我本会更喜欢像《僵尸毁灭工程》那样的系统，在那里你必须用负面特质来平衡正面特质。选择‘吸烟者’特质来弥补我出色的运动能力，感觉比一开始只是移除那些‘别忘了移除这些’的特质然后几乎什么都不做要有意义得多。

说到机制，这一点有点次要，但所有空间站实际上都不围绕它们的母体运行。这在金星轨道站尤其明显，在那里你可以匹配空间站的轨道和速度，而它会直接加速离开。所有关于模拟飞船系统和对接的讨论，通常都只是全速朝你的目标加速，因为轨道站实际上并不在轨道上运行。

你游玩所跨越的地图也非常奇怪。即使是你找到的那些更‘ modest’的地点，据说也居住着数百人，但它们看起来也许只能容纳五个人。游戏中最大的‘浮空器’殖民地，位于金星周围，有一个宏大的‘购物中心’，大概就是五个公司摊位，仅此而已。那个宏大的太空港（这是一个独立设施，你必须乘交通艇下到真正的殖民地）大概只能容纳两艘飞船。在一个像《星际公民》这样的游戏都能提供可信规模设施的时代，所谓的巨型港口却只有两个泊位，感觉很奇怪。见鬼，Ostranauts是一款2D游戏，在巨大的地图上开销非常小，我知道，因为我自己做过一个。所以看到金星浮空器殖民地插画里有一大群人在摩天大楼之间，头顶还有磁悬浮线路……然后在实际游戏地图里走动时却只有几个房间，仅此而已，这真的很奇怪。当然，它不必是1:1，但真的吗？你连一点尝试都不肯做，来糊弄一下这里所谓的规模吗？

我还想在这里稍微谈谈模组圈。这款游戏技术上支持创意工坊，但任何超出简单.json混搭的东西都需要第三方加载器，而开发者作为极端的骑墙派，没有禁止带有自定义程序集的模组，却禁止模组加载它们自己的程序集。最终结果是，带有自定义程序集的模组仍然存在，但现在整个过程毫无理由地变得更糟。用户不得不以粗糙的方式手动安装像BepInEx这样的东西。更新很痛苦，整个过程容易受到中间人攻击，等等等等。
这款游戏的很多部分也明确以阻止模组制作的方式编写。例如，添加新的空间站、行星等，技术上很简单，你只需填入几个值，比如它应该围绕什么运行、它应该有多远等等，但实际上这不可能，因为游戏尽管支持自定义星系格式，却明确只加载一个名为‘NewGame’的星系，并忽略其余部分。不仅如此，游戏*能够*处理提供自己星系的模组。它只是选择明确忽略它们，并且在星系名称同为‘NewGame’的情况下，选择完全覆盖而不是合并。这意味着，一个想要添加新地点的模组要么必须提供整个星系的完整替换（超级粗糙，并且会破坏任何其他也想这么做的模组），要么你必须写一堆自定义代码来注入你的新元素（不仅比应有的复杂得多，而且还会遇到上面提到的‘没有官方自定义程序集支持’问题）——这只是一个例子，但游戏的很多代码都是这样。在模组制作的每一步，你都会遇到要么是故意的无视，要么就是纯粹的无能。某些东西以非常特定的方式被硬编码，或者某些非常费力的东西却没有一个你可以直接插入东西的通用辅助工具。
我想先说明，我非常喜爱这款游戏。我已经玩了很多小时——见鬼，我甚至制作了可以说是这款游戏最早的大型扩展模组之一。

话虽如此，我必须说，就目前的状态而言，我无法推荐这款游戏。我毫不怀疑它在大约三年后会变得很好，但就目前而言？不。

就目前的状态而言，这款游戏简直是彻底坏掉了。开发者把完成他们承诺的路线图置于一切之上，而这一点显而易见。
尽管围绕复杂的NPC系统有那么多炒作，这些NPC甚至连活着都做不到。我曾在你总是会出生的那个主要空间站停靠了很长一段时间，处理各种事务之类的，而那里相当多的NPC就那么死了。还应该指出的是，这些NPC实际上并不会做任何有趣的事。你不会看到人们争吵之类的，他们能执行的最复杂活动就是空间站里的维护技师修理受损模块。所有这些关于一个活生生、会呼吸的世界的承诺，而NPC们甚至无法在一切需求都得到满足的环境中活下去。

这种粗糙贯穿了游戏玩法的各个层面——例如，游戏的一个主要（我敢说，甚至是核心）要点就是用你从残骸中拆下来的部件为自己建造一艘飞船。不仅这里使用的飞船设计相当糟糕（出于各种我无法在此展开的原因），而且那个本应模拟拾荒者翻检残骸的‘损伤处理’实现得也非常糟糕。结果是，虽然像反应堆部件这样据说极其罕见的东西相对容易找到，但像氧气压力传感器这样的普通电子元件却极其稀有。尽管有整套打捞经济系统，这些普通部件也没有任何地方可以随时购买。在我找到足够部件来建造一艘能够进行行星际航行、配有反应堆和各种大气净化器之类的强大货船的那段时间里，我仍然没有找到足够的传感器来供应我所拥有的各种生命维持系统。直到今天，尽管我从残骸上拆下了几十个反应堆，我仍然没有找到那个我需要插进污染物净化器里的污染物传感器。这让造船变得极其令人沮丧。

整个‘社交需求’系统彻底失败，因为没有任何办法能有意义地满足其中任何一项。有这么多社交需求，而玩法却归结为除了反复点击同一个‘在社交媒体上末日刷屏 lol’按钮之外什么都不做，然后再按下‘茧居’选项来恢复你在社交媒体上末日刷屏时失去的隐私。
而且不知为何，在你的PDA上末日刷屏比任何其他满足这些需求的方式都要好得多。这才是最搞笑的部分——游戏并不支持比如说下到Mescaform去和你的船员喝一杯，但即使你设法在那里和人搭上话，那仍然是满足这些需求的傻瓜方式，因为‘社交互动’系统更接近‘社交战斗’而非交谈，在满足这些需求方面很糟糕。
在这款游戏里，社交活动是一种满足社交需求的糟糕方式。

角色创建也非常、非常糟糕。很多特质基本上毫无意义（例如‘好色’只是意味着你的亲密需求上升得稍微快一点），但有几个则是灾难性地糟糕。例如，‘零重力高血容量’会影响一大堆东西。
这里有个有趣的细节：玩家角色默认就带有所有‘灾难性地糟糕’的特质。游戏的很大一部分难度来自新手不知道他们可以进入特质选择，移除那些致残的东西，然后用像‘好色’这样毫无意义的‘缺点’来替换它们，而这些缺点尽管如此还是会给你‘年龄’特质（在这款游戏里，你每选一个正面特质就会变老，每选一个负面特质就会变年轻）。你需要以和之前相同的年龄和状态开始，但现在你的能力却成倍地更强。
‘确保不要选那些会永远致残你的特质’算不上什么角色创建。我更喜欢像《僵尸毁灭工程》那样的系统，在那里你必须用负面特质来平衡正面特质。选择‘吸烟者’特质来弥补我出色的运动能力，感觉比一开始就只是移除那些‘别忘了移除这些’的特质然后几乎什么都不做要有意义得多。

说到机制，这一点有点次要，但所有空间站实际上都不围绕它们的母体运行。这在金星轨道站尤其明显，在那里你可以匹配空间站的轨道和速度，而它却会直接加速飞走。所有关于模拟飞船系统和对接的讨论，通常都只涉及以全速朝你的目标加速，因为轨道站实际上并没有在轨道上运行。

你所游玩的各种地图也非常奇怪。即使是那些更‘朴素’的地点，据说也居住着数百人，但它们看起来最多也许只能容纳五个人。游戏中最大的‘浮空器’殖民地，位于金星周围，有一个宏伟的‘购物中心’，大概就是五个公司摊位，仅此而已。那个宏伟的太空港（这是一个独立的设施，你必须乘坐交通工具下到殖民地本体）大概只能容纳两艘飞船。在一个像《星际公民》这样的游戏都能提供可信规模设施的时代，所谓的巨型港口却只有大约两个泊位，这让人感觉很奇怪。见鬼，Ostranauts是一款2D游戏，在巨大的地图上几乎没有额外开销，我知道这一点，因为我自己就做过一张。所以看到关于金星浮空器殖民地的插图，里面有摩天大楼之间的一大群人，头顶还有一条磁悬浮线路……然后在实际的游戏地图里走动时，却只有几个房间，仅此而已，这真的很奇怪。当然，它不必是1:1的，但说真的？你就不能做任何尝试来糊弄一下这里所谓的规模吗？

我还想在这里稍微谈谈模组圈。这款游戏技术上支持创意工坊，但任何超出简单.json混搭的东西都需要第三方加载器，而开发者们，作为极端的骑墙派，没有禁止带有自定义程序集的模组，却禁止模组加载它们自己的程序集。最终结果是，带有自定义程序集的模组仍然存在，但现在整个过程却毫无理由地变得更糟了。用户不得不以各种别扭的方式手动安装像BepInEx这样的东西。更新很痛苦，整个过程容易受到中间人攻击，等等等等。
游戏的很多部分也明确是以一种阻碍模组制作的方式编写的。例如，添加新的空间站、行星等，技术上很简单，你只需填入几个值，比如它应该围绕什么运行、它应该有多远等等，但在实践中，这是不可能的，因为游戏尽管支持自定义星系格式，却明确只加载一个名为‘NewGame’的星系，并忽略其余的。不仅如此，游戏*能够*处理提供自己星系的模组。它只是选择明确忽略它们，而对于那些具有相同‘NewGame’名称的星系，则选择完全覆盖而不是合并。这意味着，一个想要添加新地点的模组要么必须提供整个星系的完整替换（超级粗糙，并且会破坏任何其他也想这么做的模组），要么你必须编写一堆自定义代码来注入你的新元素（不仅比它本应具有的复杂程度高得多，而且还会遇到上面提到的‘没有官方自定义程序集支持’的问题）——这只是一个例子，但游戏的很多代码都是这样。在模组制作的每一步，你都会遇到要么是故意的无视，要么就是纯粹的无能。某些东西以非常特定的方式被硬编码，或者某些非常费力的东西却没有一个你可以直接插入东西的通用辅助工具。
同样的'NewGame'名称，选择完全覆盖而不是合并。这意味着一个想要添加新地点的模组要么必须提供整个星系系统的完整替换（超级蹩脚，并且会破坏任何其他也想做同样事情的模组），要么你必须编写一堆自定义代码来注入你的新元素（不仅比它本应具有的复杂度高得多，而且还会遇到上面提到的'没有官方自定义程序集支持'的问题）——这只是一个例子，但游戏的大量代码都是这样。在模组制作的每一步，你都会遇到要么是故意的无视，要么就是纯粹的无能。某些东西以非常特定的方式被硬编码，或者某些非常费力的东西没有你可以直接插入东西的通用辅助工具。

items.text:
Though rough around the edges and very much bearing that 'early access' shine, the early game of Ostranauts is tremendously compelling: you're saddled with more debt than god with a dingy mortgaged ship likely just barely capable of getting you out into space, and your fortune rests out in a boneyard of derelicts just chock full of loot... and other surprises. Attaining mastery in this game is visceral - every docking attempt is a dance, every system you set up and improve on your ship a direct and palpable leap forward, and once you finally assemble your own fusion drive...

Well, you've made it.

Don't get me wrong - the game has plenty of issues, ones born mostly of ongoing development, however. The combat and social systems are to be gentle, a [b]mess[/b]. The long distances involved in cross-planet travel mean you'll be using super fast forward a lot, except SFF doesn't automatically tend to your character's needs, so a several-day journey is instead broken up into chunks of skipping interspersed with desperately trying to get your characters to tend to their physical needs... upwards of ten times or more across a single trip.

If you enjoy games with steep initial learning curves, a real sense of accomplishment, traversing technical systems described with in-character manuals (real and soulful!), cutting bits off old derelict ships and artfully arranging them onto your own, and trying to weave around a world that genuinely wants to kill you at the drop of a hat, Ostranauts is definitely the game for you. And really, it is one of a kind.

EDIT:

Bizarrely, this game is now 1.0 and considered "released" when it is genuinely nowhere near finished. The above review was written when much of the game's relatively shallow loop was still new to me and expectations for its development over time were high. It is otherwise ridden with bugs and its modding scene is essentially soft-reset every time a new patch is released, which is OFTEN.

It's very disappointing to see what it has (or hasn't, really) become.
items.text_zh:
尽管粗糙且带着明显的“抢先体验”光泽，《Ostranauts》的早期游戏极具吸引力：你背负着比上帝还多的债务，只有一艘破旧且抵押出去的飞船，勉强能把你送入太空，而你的财富就寄托在一片满是废弃飞船的坟场里，那里塞满了战利品……还有其他惊喜。精通这款游戏是刻骨铭心的——每一次对接尝试都是一场舞蹈，你在飞船上建立和改进的每一个系统都是直接而可感知的飞跃，而当你终于组装出自己的聚变引擎……

好吧，你成功了。

别误会——这款游戏有很多问题，但大多源于持续开发。战斗和社交系统说得客气点，是一团[b]乱麻[/b]。跨行星旅行涉及的长距离意味着你会大量使用超级快进，但SFF并不会自动照顾角色的需求，所以几天的旅程被拆成一段段跳过，中间夹杂着拼命让你的角色满足生理需求……一趟旅行下来多达十几次甚至更多。

如果你喜欢初始学习曲线陡峭、有真正成就感、通过角色内手册（真实而深情！）描述的技术系统来探索、从旧废弃飞船上切下零件并巧妙地安装到自己的船上、并试图在一个随时可能置你于死地的世界中周旋的游戏，那么《Ostranauts》绝对是你的菜。而且说真的，它独一无二。

编辑：

奇怪的是，这款游戏现在已经是1.0版并被视为“正式发布”，而它实际上远未完成。上面的评论写于游戏相对浅薄的循环对我还很新鲜、对其后续开发的期望很高的时候。除此之外，它充斥着bug，而且每次发布新补丁（非常频繁）时，其模组社区基本上都会被软重置。

看到它变成（或者说，其实没变成）这样，非常令人失望。
